environment.description: Celery worker deployed via systemd unit with RootDirectory=/srv/worker-chroot. The chroot tree is assembled at deploy time by a Nix derivation that copies only the Python interpreter, celery package, and application code. The chroot contains: /app/ (application), /usr/lib/ (shared libs), /usr/bin/python3 (interpreter). No /etc/passwd, /etc/shadow, /proc, /sys, or any credential files exist within the chroot boundary. The systemd unit also sets ProtectSystem=strict, PrivateDevices=yes, and NoNewPrivileges=yes. The worker process runs as a dedicated service account (uid 30001) with no login shell defined outside the chroot. The Redis broker connection uses a Unix domain socket at /app/run/redis.sock (forwarded via socat from host).
